ns2:course.label: Theories of Measurement I
ns2:course.description: Classical test theory (true score, error of measurement, reliability and validity of test scores, composite measures); proposed alternatives to the classical model (generalizability theory, matrix sampling, latent trait theory, criterion-referenced measurement). Same as PSYC 595. Prerequisite: EPSY 580 or PSYC 407; PSYC 490; or equivalents.
